hero.title: Your U.S. college volleyball journey starts here.
hero.description: Complete this assessment so our team can evaluate your athletic and academic profile.
hero.trust: Secure assessment · About 8 minutes · No commitment

sections.athleteDescription: Use the athlete’s legal information and best contact details.
sections.volleyballDescription: Help us understand your playing background and current level.
sections.academicsDescription: U.S. opportunities depend on both athletic and academic fit.
sections.goalsDescription: A few final details help us provide the right guidance.
sections.guardianDescription: Because the athlete is under 18, these fields and guardian consent are required.

fields.representativePlaceholder: Team, age group, year and competition
fields.achievementsPlaceholder: Individual awards, titles, selections or statistics
fields.coachContactPlaceholder: Email and/or phone with country code
fields.annualBudget: Approximate annual family budget for university
fields.annualBudgetHelp: Include tuition, housing and meals. Choose the closest range in USD.
fields.mainGoal: Main goal in the United States
fields.concern: Biggest concern about the recruiting process
fields.marketingSource: How did you hear about us?
fields.guardianConsent: I confirm that I am the athlete’s parent/legal guardian and authorize this assessment.
fields.privacyConsent: I have read the privacy notice and consent to Venture Sports USA processing this information to assess recruiting opportunities.
fields.contactConsent: I agree that Venture Sports USA may contact the athlete and, when applicable, the guardian by email, phone or WhatsApp about this assessment.

validation.phone: Include a valid country code and phone number.
validation.url: Enter a valid link beginning with http:// or https://.
validation.birthDate: Enter a valid date of birth.
validation.futureDate: The date of birth cannot be in the future.
validation.guardian: Parent or guardian information is required for athletes under 18.

notifications.error: We could not save your assessment. Please try again.
notifications.duplicate: An application with these contact details has already been submitted.
notifications.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait and try again later.
notifications.invalidSubmission: Some information could not be validated. Please review your answers.

confirmation.title: Thank you, {{name}}!
confirmation.message: Venture Sports USA will review your volleyball and academic profile. If your profile qualifies for the next step, our team will contact you within 2–3 business days.
confirmation.step1: Our recruiting team reviews your profile and videos.
confirmation.step2: We assess your academic and athletic fit for U.S. universities.
confirmation.step3: Qualified athletes are contacted to discuss next steps.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.body: The information submitted through this assessment is used by Venture Sports USA to evaluate potential university recruiting opportunities and communicate with the athlete or guardian. Do not submit sensitive information that is not requested. It is stored in Venture Sports USA’s CRM and must be retained or deleted in accordance with the organization’s formal privacy policy and applicable law.
